description: Make troll combat seize, retain, use, bargain over, and relinquish the player's real weapons without replacing canonical combat.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE WEAPON-FUNCTION (W V)
	<COND (<NOT <IN? .V ,HERE>> <RFALSE>)
	      (<VERB? TAKE>
	       <COND (<IN? .W .V>
		      <TELL
"The " D .V " swings it out of your reach." CR>)
		     (T
		      <TELL
"The " D .W " seems white-hot. You can't hold on to it." CR>)>
	       T)>>

<ROUTINE TROLL-STOLEN-WEAPON ()
	<COND (<IN? ,SWORD ,TROLL> ,SWORD)
	      (<IN? ,KNIFE ,TROLL> ,KNIFE)
	      (<IN? ,RUSTY-KNIFE ,TROLL> ,RUSTY-KNIFE)
	      (T <RFALSE>)>>

<ROUTINE TROLL-REFRESH-LDESC ("AUX" W)
	<COND (<SET W <TROLL-STOLEN-WEAPON>>
	       <PUTP ,TROLL ,P?LDESC
"A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a weapon taken from you, blocks all passages out of the room.">)
	      (<IN? ,AXE ,TROLL>
	       <PUTP ,TROLL ,P?LDESC
"A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages out of the room.">)
	      (T
	       <PUTP ,TROLL ,P?LDESC "A troll is here.">)>>

<ROUTINE TROLL-DROP-STOLEN-WEAPONS ()
	<COND (<IN? ,SWORD ,TROLL>
	       <MOVE ,SWORD ,HERE>
	       <FCLEAR ,SWORD ,NDESCBIT>
	       <FSET ,SWORD ,WEAPONBIT>)>
	<COND (<IN? ,KNIFE ,TROLL>
	       <MOVE ,KNIFE ,HERE>
	       <FCLEAR ,KNIFE ,NDESCBIT>
	       <FSET ,KNIFE ,WEAPONBIT>)>
	<COND (<IN? ,RUSTY-KNIFE ,TROLL>
	       <MOVE ,RUSTY-KNIFE ,HERE>
	       <FCLEAR ,RUSTY-KNIFE ,NDESCBIT>
	       <FSET ,RUSTY-KNIFE ,WEAPONBIT>)>>

<ROUTINE TROLL-CAPTURE-WEAPON (W)
	<MOVE .W ,TROLL>
	<FSET .W ,NDESCBIT>
	<FSET ,TROLL ,FIGHTBIT>
	<COND (<EQUAL? .W ,AXE>
	       <TELL "The troll hooks the falling axe with one thick hand and reclaims it before it reaches the floor." CR>)
	      (T
	       <TELL "Before the " D .W " can hit the floor, the troll snatches it out of the air. He tests the balance, grins at you, and keeps it." CR>)>
	<TROLL-REFRESH-LDESC>
	<RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE TROLL-STOLEN-BLOW-REMARK (RES DWEAPON "AUX" W)
	<SET W <TROLL-STOLEN-WEAPON>>
	<COND (<EQUAL? .RES ,MISSED>
	       <TELL "The troll tries your own " D .W " against you, but you twist clear of the stroke." CR>)
	      (<EQUAL? .RES ,UNCONSCIOUS>
	       <TELL "The troll clubs you unconscious with the " D .W " he took from you." CR>)
	      (<EQUAL? .RES ,KILLED>
	       <TELL "The troll proves that losing the " D .W " was more than an inventory problem. Your own weapon finishes the fight." CR>)
	      (<EQUAL? .RES ,LIGHT-WOUND>
	       <TELL "The troll draws a shallow line with your stolen " D .W ". The insult is almost worse than the cut." CR>)
	      (<EQUAL? .RES ,SERIOUS-WOUND>
	       <TELL "Your stolen " D .W " comes back at you in the troll's hands and lands hard enough to make the loss immediately consequential." CR>)
	      (<EQUAL? .RES ,STAGGER>
	       <TELL "The troll drives you backward with the " D .W " he stole from you, leaving you staggered." CR>)
	      (<EQUAL? .RES ,LOSE-WEAPON>
	       <TELL "The troll catches your " D .DWEAPON " with your stolen " D .W " and tears it from your grip." CR>)
	      (<EQUAL? .RES ,HESITATE>
	       <TELL "The troll pauses to admire your stolen " D .W ", apparently enjoying the ownership dispute." CR>)
	      (T
	       <TELL "The troll commits fully with your stolen " D .W ", and you have no room left to recover." CR>)>>
